title: Collexa
subtitle: Social Platform / Mobile & Cross-Platform App
description:
Bahria University's social campus app — Flutter & Firebase

Collexa is a full-featured campus social platform built for Bahria University students. It unifies social feeds, group communities, real-time messaging, events, confessions, and lost & found into a single cross-platform Flutter application backed entirely by Firebase.

Collexa covers the full spectrum of campus social life — from anonymous confessions and group communities to real-time chats and lost & found boards. Every feature is built on Firebase's real-time infrastructure for instant, offline-resilient delivery.

title: FYP Automation System
subtitle: Enterprise Academic Automation · Bahria University, Islamabad
description:
A policy-enforced, end-to-end platform that replaces two semesters worth of paper forms, physical logbooks, email chains, and manual panel scheduling — with a single unified system.

Bahria University's FYP lifecycle — Proposal through Final Defense — spanned eight months and seven stakeholder types. Every handoff was manual. Every deadline communicated by email. Every logbook a physical notebook that could be lost, backdated, or simply never filled.

Students maintained handwritten Annex-A logbooks. Entries were routinely backdated at end-of-semester. Supervisors had no central visibility. The mandatory 24-entry rule existed only on paper.

title: PhishSim
subtitle: A hybrid browser extension that combines machine learning classification with rule-based heuristics to identify phishing URLs in real time — before th
description:
Traditional blacklists and browser warnings operate on known threats, leaving users exposed to novel, freshly-registered phishing domains.

Enterprise-grade threat detection tools are too resource-intensive for browser-level integration, creating a gap in everyday protection.

Even when threats are flagged, users receive no insight into why a site was marked suspicious — reducing trust and actionability.

title: ResumeAI
subtitle: A full-stack intelligent recruitment platform that parses uploaded resumes using NLP, extracts structured candidate data, and matches applicants again
description:
Every job posting attracts hundreds of resumes. Human recruiters, faced with inconsistent formats and volume pressure, make hasty, biased decisions — missing strong candidates and wasting days on manual extraction.

ResumeAI parses uploaded resumes in any format, extracts structured candidate profiles using spaCy NLP, stores everything in a relational database, and ranks applicants against job descriptions using cosine similarity — all behind a clean, secure dashboard.

A full-stack recruitment intelligence platform — tested end-to-end across Chrome and Firefox, all 11 API endpoints secured and validated, no critical bugs in final sprint.

title: Scounts
subtitle: FinTech / Digital Tax Consultancy Platform · Pakistan
description:
Pakistan's private digital tax partner — income tax, NTN registration & salary calculations, simplified.

Scounts is a private tax consultancy mobile application serving Pakistani taxpayers. It guides users through income tax return filing, NTN registration, and salary tax calculation via a step-by-step interface — backed by verified Federal Board of Revenue (FBR) data and a team of tax professionals.

Scounts distils the complexity of Pakistan's tax system into a guided, jargon-free mobile experience. From first-time filers registering an NTN to salaried professionals calculating their annual liability — every service is accessible without a visit to an FBR office or a tax lawyer's office.

title: VitalWatch
subtitle: Health & Wellness / Real-Time Monitoring App
description:
Real-time health monitoring via Apple HealthKit & Google Fit APIs

VitalWatch is a cross-platform Flutter health companion that streams live biometric data from Apple HealthKit and Google Fit, tracks daily wellness metrics, dispatches emergency alerts to saved contacts, and generates exportable weekly health reports — all from a single unified profile.

VitalWatch unifies real-time biometric monitoring with actionable daily wellness tracking. API-sourced sensor data from Apple and Google ensures clinical-grade accuracy — far beyond what manual input or on-device sensors alone can provide.

title: ZenoShell
subtitle: An AI-augmented Linux terminal that understands natural language, speaks back to you, and executes commands — all offline.
description:
Linux terminals are powerful — but ruthlessly inaccessible. Developers waste hours memorizing arcane syntax, debugging opaque error messages, and switching between shell, browser, and documentation just to run routine tasks. There was no intelligence layer, no voice, no help.

ZenoShell is a two-module AI system — a text-based Z-Terminal and a Voice Assistant — that runs entirely offline using local models. It interprets natural language, explains errors in plain English, and responds out loud. No API keys. No cloud.
